subject: ONE sleek red fox in a tiny green accountant's visor, fluffy tail
second_characters: ONE stout badger tax collector in a grey cap, flinging honey-soaked envelopes from a dripping satchel in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE old tree stump oozing a wide golden puddle of honey; plain brown envelopes dripping honey

environment: a dense sunny autumn forest clearing packed with ferns, birches and beehives, no empty ground
lighting: bright warm afternoon sun through leaves, honey glowing amber
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the fox fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat. She never stands still: ducking, twisting, sidestepping, tail whipping. The camera orbits her on a hard arc, never parking, the whole clearing wheeling round her, a new shot size every beat. Envelopes, honey drops and leaves tear across the lens in EVERY beat; in speech beats they pass beside her face, never over her mouth. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: smooth sly female voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.60, then the honey and the badger carry it
audio.lip_sync: the fox herself speaks, mouth opening on every syllable, brows and jaw alive
audio.pronunciation: na-LO-gi kak MYOD. chem u-vo-RA-chi-va-esh-sya, tem SIL-ne-ye pri-LIP-nesh pa-TOM

timeline.a: chest-up, mouth working, she twists aside as a dripping envelope flies past her ear, honey drops whipping across the lens
the badger hurls two envelopes at once and she sidesteps one and twists hard from the other, tail whipping across the lens
very close, mouth working, she sways sideways from a flying envelope and whips back, the honey stump glinting behind her, an envelope flying past her shoulder
chest-up, mouth working, she spins clear of a splat straight into the honey puddle by the stump, one hind paw sinking, leaves raking across the lens
she yanks the paw and the honey stretches like rubber, pulling her back, an envelope slapping onto her tail
she heaves the other way and both front paws plunge into the honey, the badger flinging envelopes across the lens
she wrenches round and her whole side flops against the stump, stuck solid, leaves bursting across the lens
she thrashes against the stump as the badger slaps envelope after envelope onto her fur, each slap jolting her
she tugs her tail free with a wet snap and it springs back covered in envelopes, honey drops across the lens
still glued, she jerks her head round to the lens with a flat stare and blinks once, tail lashing, the badger tipping his cap across the lens

must_appear: 0.00 the fox in her visor dodging a flying envelope; 3.70 her paw sinking in the honey by the stump; 7.00 her whole side stuck to the stump; 9.20 her flat stare, fur plastered with envelopes
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a horizontal 16:9 picture, letterbox, a hero running at the camera on her feet, a conveyor belt, a cart, a parked camera, a still or empty background, standing in place, wide shot, a small distant hero, night, dark scene, a hero back to the camera, a closed mouth while speaking, a paw over her mouth, an envelope over her mouth, offscreen narration, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.60, English speech, foreign accent, bees, a second fox
